_about: The clinch's grip layer (docs/animation/clinch-sizing.md slice C2; AnimFighter._grip_layer). The sim's hold arrives as a read (AnimFighter.on_hold): partner (the other fighter's slot), kind (tie, pummel, brace, pin, carry, strain, whiff, apart), role (holder, or held for the pinned body), grade (-2 behind to 2 ahead; a tie-up mixes the seat toward ahead or behind by it), side (l or r, for the pummel) and grips (each gripping hand to a region of the partner's body in sockets.json). The layer mixes the pose of the kind in at a weight that ramps over ramp_ticks, then solves each gripping hand by IK onto its region, and ends any frame's hand short of its point by the gap budget at most, never bending past a limit to reach (the shortfall is counted in debug.grip_gap_max). hand_back: how much of the hand's length the wrist stands short of the region's point. depth_offset: how far each body steps out of the plane, in opposite directions (render only), so arms reaching across pass. poses: the pose of each kind (the wave cl1); held_poses: the pose of the pinned body. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. First values, Animation's.
